title: TikTok Shop affiliate
one_liner: Earn a commission when people buy products you show on TikTok.
followers: Reported 1,000 followers (3rd party; check TikTok's page).
pay: Commission set per product by the seller; TikTok publishes no fixed rate.
steps: Join TikTok Shop affiliate in TikTok Studio.
Show them in use; tag the product.
catch: Only in TikTok Shop countries; commissions vary and returns can cancel them.

match.first_step: List 5 products you use daily that sell on TikTok Shop.
